title: Pure Phase-B Standard-WOFOST Finalize-Rate Provider
goal: Implement and qualify the read-only phase-B provider that converts an already prepared actual PGASS plus accepted one-day root-uptake/potential-transpiration aggregates into the exact restricted F-WOF26 one-day rate packet for standard WOFOST.
output: wofost_one_day_rate_packet_t consumed atomically by F-WOF26 structural evolution
formula_order: DVR = DVRED*DTSUM/TSUMEA for DVS<1, otherwise DTSUM/TSUMAM; DVRED=1 for IDSL=0 and max(0,min(1,(DAYLP-DLC)/(DLO-DLC))) for IDSL=1
FR/FL/FS/FO = AFGEN partition tables and preserve B1.10 CHCKPRT arithmetic/order and 1e-4 criterion
HELP=0; when CVO>0 HELP=FO/CVO; qualified strengthening rejects FO>0 with CVO<=0
preserve B1.10 CHCKCBL arithmetic/order and 1e-4 criterion
when LAIEXP<6: GLAIEXP=RELTR*LAIEXP*RGRLAI*max(0,TAV-TBASE); GLASOL=GRLV*SLAT; GLA=min(GLAIEXP,GLASOL); when GRLV>0 SLAT=GLA/GRLV
when LAIEXP>=6: do not recompute GLAIEXP; F-WOF26 uses the reference compatibility carryover sidecar

ownership_boundaries.anthesis_first_crossing_truncation: F-WOF26 structural evolution, not this provider
ownership_boundaries.leaf_lifespan_death: F-WOF26 structural cohort evolution, not this provider
ownership_boundaries.GLAIEXP_saved_rate_carryover: F-WOF26 owner compatibility sidecar, not persistent rate-provider state

accepted_window_provenance_contract.producer_rule: runtime may materialize this carrier only from committed/accepted process contributions for the crop window
accepted_window_provenance_contract.rejected_trial_rule: rejected or rolled-back solver trials contribute exactly zero to the carrier
accepted_window_provenance_contract.window_rule: IQROT and IPTRA must refer to the same crop event window and same accepted trajectory
accepted_window_provenance_contract.provider_rule: F-WOF32 treats the carrier as frozen read-only input and never accumulates trial contributions itself

fail_closed_rules: state view and prepared actual_pgass must be finite; actual_pgass must be nonnegative
accepted aggregate values must be finite and nonnegative
TAV must be finite; DAYLP is validated only for IDSL=1 and must then lie in 0..24 h
evaluated RFSETB, partition fractions, root/stem relative death and SLAT must remain inside B1.10 parser y-ranges 0..1
restricted F-WOF26 packet requires evaluated DTSUM in 0..100; negative parser-admissible DTSMTB output is not silently clamped
partition closure must satisfy the B1.10 CHCKPRT criterion
FO>0 with CVO<=0 fails closed rather than silently dropping the storage conversion term
CVF denominator and all produced packet fields must be finite and denominator-safe

explicit_restrictions_or_discrepancies.finding: B1.10 parser range permits DTSMTB y down to -10, while the already qualified F-WOF26 structural packet contract admits only nonnegative temperature_sum_increment.
explicit_restrictions_or_discrepancies.disposition: fail closed when the evaluated DTSMTB result is negative; do not clamp or silently broaden the F-WOF26 contract in this work unit

explicit_restrictions_or_discrepancies.finding: B1.10 sets HELP=0 whenever CVO<=0, even when FO>0, thereby dropping the storage-organ conversion contribution.
explicit_restrictions_or_discrepancies.disposition: fail closed for FO>0 with CVO<=0, as already required by the F-WOF27/F-WOF30 domain-strengthening contract

not_qualified: runtime production binding that proves IQROT/IPTRA lineage from accepted solver contributions
end-to-end crop-day orchestration of prepare -> soil substeps -> accepted aggregate -> finalize rates -> structural commit
